Maya K: Running into CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED when using python-sdk in a Windows venv (py3.11). Same code works on linux and py3.9 on same laptop.
Maya K: Stack: python.org 3.11.4, venv, sdk 0.7.0. Traceback during simple client call: 
```
requests.exceptions.SSLError: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed: unable to get local issuer certificate (_ssl.c:997)
```
Shiv P: Do we know the SSL backend? python.org builds may bundle OpenSSL which changes cert lookup. Can you check `ssl.OPENSSL_VERSION`?
Maya K: Shows OpenSSL 3.0.10. I tried same venv with py3.9 and it works.
Alice L: Temporary workaround: pip install certifi and set SSL_CERT_FILE to certifi.where() or construct ssl.SSLContext(cafile=certifi.where()).
Ben T: Example: 
```python
import ssl, certifi
ctx = ssl.create_default_context(cafile=certifi.where())
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=..., ssl_context=ctx)
```
Ben T: If that works, we'll add cert resolution precedence (env -> certifi -> system) and expose ssl_context param on AsyncClient as well.
Maya K: Setting SSL_CERT_FILE to certifi.where() fixes my repro. Confirmed.
cert-bot: Created INF-3421: "py sdk: windows 3.11 venv cert verification precedence" - https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3421
Shiv P: Good. @Alice L can you draft a quickstart note for Windows users?
Alice L: Draft: "If you see CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED on Windows, install certifi and set SSL_CERT_FILE to certifi.where(), or pass an ssl.SSLContext(cafile=certifi.where()) to the client." I'll open a docs PR.
Ben T: Opened draft SDK PR to prefer SSL_CERT_FILE then certifi then system, and to accept ssl_context on both sync and async clients: https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-sdk/pull/215 (draft). Adds type stubs for AsyncClient param.
Maya K: Built wheel from PR branch and verified fix on py3.11 venv. No SSLError now.
cert-bot: INF-3421 status updated -> triaged (priority: P2)
Ben T: Will add changelog and cut 0.7.1 after docs merged.
Maya K: Thanks all! Leaving thread until release + docs merged. :thumbsup:
